final: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind HAVING AVG(s.anlycount) IS NOT NULL), om AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS m FROM pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - om.m AS margin FROM pairs p, om WHERE p.pair_avg > om.m), per AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_anly, AVG(margin) AS avg_margin FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_anly, avg_margin, avg_anly / (SELECT AVG(avg_anly) FROM per) AS rel_to_mean FROM per
